Container.Name: speedketchup
Container.Overview:
Know what your internet really delivers.
Runs an internet speed test every 10 minutes against the nearest speedtest.net server, stores the results in a csv file and shows them in a builtin web page.
The web page has speed and latency charts with distributions of the displayed results, daily, monthly, time of day and time of week averages, and a sortable table of every result.
A single statically linked binary of a few hundred kilobytes, the container image has nothing else in it.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: speedtest speed test internet bandwidth latency ping monitoring
Container.Changes: ### 2026-10-23 - speedketchup 0.4.0: InfluxDB and MQTT with Home Assistant discovery settings. - Initial template for speedketchup 0.3.0.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Web page with the test results.

Config.Name: Results
Config.Description: Where the test results csv file is stored.

Config.Name: Speedtest server
Config.Description: Speedtest server host[:port] to always test against, empty picks the server with the lowest latency for every test.

Config.Name: Download duration
Config.Description: Seconds to test the download speed, 0 skips the download test.

Config.Name: Upload duration
Config.Description: Seconds to test the upload speed, 0 skips the upload test.

Config.Name: Download connections
Config.Description: Parallel connections for the download test.

Config.Name: Upload connections
Config.Description: Parallel connections for the upload test.

Config.Name: InfluxDB write url
Config.Description: InfluxDB line protocol write url to also write every result to, http only, eg http://influxdb:8086/api/v2/write?org=home&bucket=speedketchup. Empty writes nowhere.

Config.Name: InfluxDB token
Config.Description: Token for the InfluxDB write url.

Config.Name: MQTT broker
Config.Description: MQTT broker host[:port] to also publish every result to, with Home Assistant discovery, plain mqtt only, port 1883 by default. Empty publishes nowhere.

Config.Name: MQTT user
Config.Description: User name for the MQTT broker.
